name: refactor_node_promise_chain_to_async
description: Refactors nested Promise .then() chains into async/await while preserving results and error propagation
prompts: buildSummary(userId) in pipeline.js chains Promises with nested .then() calls: it fetches a user, then that user's orders, then summarizes them (the three step functions come from ./steps.js and each returns a Promise). Refactor buildSummary to use async/await instead of .then() chaining. Preserve behavior exactly: it still returns a Promise resolving to the same summary object, and a rejection from any step (e.g. an unknown user) must still propagate to the caller (do NOT swallow errors). Keep the module export and the buildSummary(userId) signature. Do not modify steps.js.
